About Us:

   

The people of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK) are united by a singular mission: ending cancer for life. Our specialized care teams provide personalized, compassionate, expert care to patients of all ages. Informed by basic research done at our Sloan Kettering Institute, scientists across MSK collaborate to conduct innovative translational and clinical research that is driving a revolution in our understanding of cancer as a disease and improving the ability to prevent, diagnose, and treat it. MSK is dedicated to training the next generation of scientists and clinicians, who go on to pursue our mission at MSK and around the globe.

 

Service is at the heart of what we do, and we take pride in delivering outstanding customer service and providing a safe, clean, and welcoming environment for our patients. Apply now to join our team as a Logistics Associate at our Breast & Imaging Center 66th street location and kick start your career!

Role Overview:

  • Order supplies from vendors and manage software systems like Helios, UPS, Vuetura, and Coupa.

  • Prevent stock-outs by proactively ordering and offering alternatives when items are unavailable.

  • Notify management of supply shortages and suggest cost-saving measures.

  • Verify deliveries, unpack, and distribute supplies accurately and timely to patient floors and clinical areas.

  • Monitor expiration dates and replenish supplies, linens, oxygen tanks, and pantry items daily.

  • Process returns, manage mail distribution, and oversee deliveries using VueturaTrac.

  • Supervise truck deliveries, assign loading bays, and provide necessary unloading equipment.

  • Inspect received items for accuracy and report discrepancies.

Key Qualification & Core Skills:

  • Able to optimally communicate.

  • Must be able to work independently and have analytical and problem solving skills.

Additional Information:

  • Location: 300 East. 66th st(BAIC)

  • Schedule: Monday - Friday, 5 am – 1pm. Weekends as needed

  • Report to Assistant Manager, Materials Management
